name: lock-race-reconciliation
body:
Reconciliation of the spec-review feedback on the lock-race spec (feedback-1..7). Each item was actioned against the durable nodes; the reviewer resolves.

1. evaluate-fix-ladder (feedback-1): ladder re-derived — option (c) DB decoupling removes DB contention only and is NOT structurally race-free (the node-file RMW at src/node_cmd.rs:207 and the git index commit still race). Chosen race fix is (a) file-level serialization over the whole durable sequence; (d) the session coordinator is mandatory for amortization + batching and serializes while a session is live; (c) is a complement; (b) a last resort.
2. concurrent-bursts-reliable (feedback-2): the zero-lock-failures AC now covers all three locks — lbug's DB lock, the `specs.lock` flock, and `.git/index.lock`.
3. lock-race-evidence + domain.entity.file-lock (feedback-3): the mutation path takes a third lock, `.git/index.lock` via `git::commit_files` (src/git.rs:587-645); `file-lock` widened to the general file/index locks; "race each other" corrected to "race other concurrent processes" (intra-process opens are sequential).
4. coordinator-lifecycle-exclusivity (feedback-4): mid-request death now specifies apply-once idempotency via a client request id + report-never-silently-retry; read-only openers (`apg query` / suite tools) stated to keep working while a session is live.
5. coordinator-single-writer (feedback-5): the coordinator owns the whole durable write (node-file RMW + commit + projection record), not merely the DB; read-only openers widened in the AC; coordinator-buffer-derived-only aligned.
6. session-mutation-coordinator (feedback-6): the coordinator is now explicitly MANDATORY (not contingent) — the tree, prefer-structural-fix, and coordinator-planned-anchoring are made consistent; coverage ambiguity removed.
7. db-rebuildable-projection (feedback-7): the no-index fallback is defined — with no DB, no graph.jsonl, and no symbol index, code-FQN `implemented-by` refs are recorded unvalidated (structural refs always validated) and re-checked on the next scan.

[reconciliation]
